verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics middleware/framework for real-time communication between nodes, not a job/workflow scheduler; the evidence covers pub/sub, services, actions, QoS, security, launch systems, and CLI tools, none of which constitute recurring job/workflow scheduling akin to cron or automation-platform triggers. This capability is outside ROS 2's product category as a robotics middleware, so the axis does not apply.
